post.description: Builds one or more rotating proxy connection strings from dashboard-style options. Use locations first to choose valid country, city, and state values. Use this instead of the v1 smart parameters builder.

city.description: City name. Spaces are encoded as underscores.

credentialId.description: Credential id returned by GET /v2/proxy/rotating/credentials. If omitted, the first credential is used.

quantity.description: Number of connection strings to generate. Matches the dashboard limit.

rotation.description: Rotation value: -1 for each request, 0 for sticky, or interval minutes.

state.description: State or subdivision value, when available for the country.

connections.description: Generated connection strings. Contains one item by default.

cacheMaxAgeDays.description: Maximum age of cached content in days.

city.description: City for the request exit location.

difficulty.description: Access difficulty pool. Defaults to the upstream default.

url.description: Target page URL to fetch through Web Data.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the fetch completed.

html.description: HTML content returned by the target page.
